[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-cb0e626f28]
Append to p7-q9: (b) Find Q dividing the same interval from A to B in the ratio 3:2. Answer: (-1,3). (c) Find the midpoint of PQ. Answer: (-1.5,4). (d) Find the midpoint of AB. Answer: (-1.5,4).
